rows.label: The New War
rows.note: unlocks Narmer Bounties from Konzu and Eudico

bonuses: Narmer Bounties are level 50-70 with no Mastery Rank requirement.

groups.sub: or Plains of Eidolon, Cetus, same rates
conditions: Only Rotation C carries the Korumm roll. The board cycles A/B/C every 150 minutes, so C is up 2.5 hours out of every 7.5; farm Isoplast in A and B.
Complete every stage's bonus objective: the all-bonus reward is an extra stage 5 roll, the best Isoplast and blueprint roll.
Leaving the landscape or returning to town cancels the bounty; completed stage rewards are kept.
Don't trade spare Isoplast for standing yet; Caliban, Verdilac, Nepheri and Venato draw from the same pool.
bonuses: Farm Caliban, Verdilac, Nepheri and Venato at the same time; they share these bounties and all need Narmer Isoplast.
Volt, Nova or Wisp speed up drone-escort stages, the slowest stage type.

disclosures.title: why Fortuna over Cetus
disclosures.body: The drop tables are identical. Vallis objectives stay closer to Fortuna, while Plains bounties send you across the map and into caves. On Cetus, if the Narmer Grineer captain is disarmed (Chesa Kubrow, disarm abilities) before every Vomvalyst dies, he becomes invincible and the bounty stalls.

disclosures.title: the odds
disclosures.body: Around 5 full Rotation-C bounties clear the blueprint on average; bad luck can run past 15. Objectives are randomized when you pick the bounty, so you can't choose a short layout.

rows.label: Korumm
rows.note: 16 Narmer Isoplast, 6 Radiant Zodian, 60 Coprite Alloy, 3,200 Rubedo

conditions: Korumm alerts enemies in about 30 m on every attack except finishers; don't level it on a stealth setup.

disclosures.title: hidden from Profile Progress
disclosures.body: Korumm is hidden from the Codex and the Profile Progress list. Check the Arsenal or the wiki's hidden-Mastery list to confirm it's mastered.
